Hørsholm is a Danish municipality mentioned in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report benchmarks clinical quality in atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, specifically tracking indicators such as the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulant therapy (Indicator 5) using data from the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) [^src1]. Hørsholm's specific statistical results for Indicator 5 are tabulated on page 93 of the document [^src1]. 

Beyond this single tabular entry, the provided corpus contains no further claims, relationships, or timeline events regarding Hørsholm, and no related entities are linked to this page.
